purpose: This table provides cleaned, line-item-level online retail transaction data (invoices, products, quantities, prices, customers, and countries) for downstream sales, returns, and customer analytics.
usage: Consumers should treat invoice plus stockcode as the row grain, filter on is_return to separate returned or cancelled line items (quantity < 0) from standard sales, and expect customer_id to be null for roughly 30% of rows representing guest or unidentified purchases.
limitations: Exact duplicate rows (duplicate_row_rate 0.011188 of 45228 rows) are dropped, description remains nullable for 0.5% of rows, customer_id remains nullable for about 29.8% of rows with no imputation performed, and the is_return flag is derived only from the sign of quantity rather than from invoice-number prefixes, which the profile's samples did not evidence.
